sys_script_include.description: Script to bulk upgrade your company's applications to the latest versions. It will either use the system property bulk_convert_store_app.convertible_apps (containing scope names) or you may call it yourself and pass a filter for the apps you wish to upgrade (e.g. "is_store_app=false" will usually return all of your custom apps).
sys_script_include.name: BulkUpgradeMyCompanyApps
